user.title: RF Presence Sense — Floorplan & Receivers
user.description: Configure your floorplan dimensions and the 3D position of your existing Wi-Fi router and Home Assistant Bluetooth host. No extra ESP32 or BT proxy is required.

devices.title: Select Stationary Wi-Fi & Bluetooth Devices
devices.description: Found {wifi_count} Wi-Fi/RF RSSI entities and {ble_count} Bluetooth devices. Select ONLY stationary devices (smart plugs, bulbs, switches, sensors, TVs) — avoid phones or wearables.

init.title: RF Presence Sense — Settings
init.description: Manage tuning, stationary devices, 3D device positions, or rooms. Changes to positions and rooms are persisted automatically.

data.active_poll_entities: Active polling entities (for slow Wi-Fi RSSI sensors)
data.away_entity: Optional away/presence entity (e.g. zone.home or input_boolean)

devices.title: Manage Stationary Wi-Fi & Bluetooth Devices
devices.description: Found {wifi_count} Wi-Fi/RF entities and {ble_count} Bluetooth devices (max {max_links} active links). Existing 3D coordinates are preserved.

positions.title: Select Device or Receiver
positions.description: Choose a stationary device or receiver ([RX]) to adjust its 3D coordinates (x, y, z).

position_edit.title: Edit 3D Position — {device_name}
position_edit.description: Set exact 3D coordinates in meters. Height Z (e.g. plug 0.35m vs. lamp 1.8m) improves human vs. animal discrimination.

rooms.title: Manage Rooms ({room_count} configured)
rooms.description: Enter Room ID and Name to create or update a room, or choose an existing room below to delete it. Room presence sensors update automatically.

calibrate_empty_room.name: Calibrate empty room
calibrate_empty_room.description: Records undisturbed RSSI baseline and noise floor for all Wi-Fi and Bluetooth links and persists them across restarts.

reset_baseline.name: Reset baseline
reset_baseline.description: Immediately resets adaptive RSSI baselines to current readings and persists them.

set_device_position.name: Set 3D device position
set_device_position.description: Sets and persists exact 3D (x, y, z) coordinates in meters for a stationary device or receiver.

device_id.name: Device or Receiver ID
device_id.description: Entity ID, BLE MAC address, or receiver ID (e.g. router_main).

define_room.name: Define room zone
define_room.description: Creates or updates a rectangular or polygon room zone, persists it, and dynamically adds its room presence binary sensors.

polygon.name: Polygon Vertices (optional)
polygon.description: Optional list of [x, y] coordinate pairs for L-shaped or custom rooms.

delete_room.name: Delete room zone
delete_room.description: Removes a configured room zone from persistent storage.

room_id.name: Room ID
room_id.description: ID of the room to delete.
